bullets.text: Aqara Launches Smart Home Devices - **Aqara** unveils new Apple-friendly doorbell and outdoor camera at IFA 2025.
CarPlay Gets Messages Upgrade - **Apple**'s iOS 26 introduces tapbacks support for CarPlay Messages.
Android 16 QPR1 Features Revealed - **Google** rolls out a major update with Material 3 Expressive for Pixel devices.
Pixel Feature Drop Announced - **Google** introduces new features including Material 3 Expressive and AI enhancements.
AirPods Pro 3 Launch Imminent - **Apple**'s next-gen AirPods Pro 3 expected to debut with enhanced features.
iPhone 17 Pro Rumors Surface - New thermal management expected to improve battery life and display performance.
Apple Supports Strong Encryption - **Apple**'s encryption stance gains backing from the FTC amid US privacy changes.
Galaxy S25 FE Leaked - **Samsung**'s upcoming Galaxy S25 FE showcases AI features in real-life images.
WhatsApp Introduces Close Friends - **Meta** adds a Close Friends feature to WhatsApp Status for selective sharing.
Anker's Innovative Products at IFA - **Anker** showcases new AI voice recorder and Nebula projector at IFA 2025.
